why: The opposite error, and the reason the reset is guarded rather than unconditional: resetting on the FIRST attach of a document load skips the Launch splash entirely. That is not merely a missing screen -- the splash gesture is what unlocks the `AudioContext` (see `app-shell.ts`'s own note on ordering), so the menu comes up silent until the player happens to click something. 1 of 18, 'leaves the splash up for the FIRST session of a document load'. Paired with `route-host-attach-never-resets-the-route`: one entry per direction, because a single test cannot fail both ways and an unguarded reset passes the other one.
